user.title: Packing lists
user.description: Creates a master packing list and lets you build a packing list for each trip from it.

data.seed_master: Start with a suggested master list

abort.single_instance_allowed: Packing lists are already set up.

create_list.name: Create packing list
create_list.description: Creates a new packing list and fills it from the master list.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Add all master items with any of these tags.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Add all master items in these categories.

items.name: Items
items.description: Add these master items (summary or uid).

include_always.name: Include #always
include_always.description: Also add every item tagged #always. Omitted = the integration's default.

use_weight.name: Use weight
use_weight.description: Show weight on the list. Omitted = the integration's default.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional notes for the packing list.

weight_limit.name: Weight limit
weight_limit.description: Maximum total weight in grams (0 or empty removes the limit). Omitted = the integration's default weight limit.

quantity_controls.name: Quantity buttons on the card
quantity_controls.description: Show − and + next to each item, so the quantity can be changed directly on the card. Omitted = the integration's default.

packed_mode.name: How packed items are shown
packed_mode.description: In their category, together at the bottom or hidden. Omitted = the integration's default.

add_from_master.name: Add from master
add_from_master.description: Adds items from the master list to a packing list. Items already on the list are skipped.

entity_id.name: Packing list
entity_id.description: The packing list to add to.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Add all master items with any of these tags.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Add all master items in these categories.

items.name: Items
items.description: Add these master items (summary or uid).

include_excluded.name: Include deleted
include_excluded.description: Also add items that were deleted from the list before.

add_master_items.name: Add to master
add_master_items.description: Adds one or more items to the master list with the same category and tags. The same name can exist once per category. If the name exists in another category, the existing item gets the new tags unless the name is in 'Move' or 'Create as new'.

items.name: Items
items.description: Names of the items (a list, or one per line).

category.name: Category
category.description: Category for all the items, e.g. Clothes.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags for all the items, e.g. summer, beach.

move.name: Move
move.description: Existing items that should be moved to the category.

duplicate.name: Create as new
duplicate.description: Items that exist in another category but should be created as a new item in the category.

reset_list.name: Clear checkmarks
reset_list.description: Unchecks every item on the packing list, so everything is not packed.

delete_list.name: Delete packing list
delete_list.description: Deletes the packing list and its entities.

update_master_item.name: Update master item
update_master_item.description: Changes the name, category, tags, quantity and/or weight of a master list item. Category, tags and weight are also updated on the packing lists.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name or uid of the item.

category.name: Category
category.description: New category. Empty removes it, omitted keeps it.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: New tags (replace the old ones). Empty list removes all tags, omitted keeps them.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Default quantity when the item is added to a packing list. 0 clears it, leaving it out keeps it.

weight.name: Weight per piece
weight.description: Weight in grams per piece. Also updated on the packing lists. 0 clears it, leaving it out keeps it.

reset_master.name: Reset master list
reset_master.description: Replaces the whole master list with the default list. Packing lists are not affected.

refresh_list.name: Fetch again
refresh_list.description: Adds new master items matching the list's tags and categories. Items deleted from the list are not brought back.

include_excluded.name: Include deleted
include_excluded.description: Also add items that were deleted from the list before.

add_list_item.name: Add item to packing list
add_list_item.description: Adds an item to a packing list with category and tags, optionally also saving it on the master list.

weight.name: Weight per piece
weight.description: Optional weight in grams per piece.

save_to_master.name: Also save to master
save_to_master.description: Also save the item on the master list.

copy_to_master.name: Save in master
copy_to_master.description: Saves an item from a packing list to the master list and links them. If the name already exists in the same category, the existing item gets the new tags.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name or uid of the item on the packing list.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category in the master (omitted = the item's own).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags in the master (omitted = the item's own).

update_list.name: Update packing list
update_list.description: Renames a packing list or changes its notes, weight setting or archived state.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Notes for the packing list (replaces the old ones).

use_weight.name: Use weight
use_weight.description: Show the weight of each item and totals per category.

archived.name: Archived
archived.description: Archive the list (or bring it back from the archive).

weight_limit.name: Weight limit
weight_limit.description: Maximum total weight in grams (0 or empty removes the limit).

quantity_controls.name: Quantity buttons on the card
quantity_controls.description: Show − and + next to each item, so the quantity can be changed directly on the card.

packed_mode.name: How packed items are shown
packed_mode.description: In their category, together at the bottom or hidden.

update_list_item.name: Update packing list item
update_list_item.description: Changes the quantity and/or weight of an item on a packing list.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item's name or uid on the packing list.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: New quantity. 0 clears it, leaving it out keeps it.

weight.name: Weight per piece
weight.description: New weight in grams per piece. 0 clears it, leaving it out keeps it.

save_to_master.name: Also save to master
save_to_master.description: Also save the weight on the master item (and so on every list that has it).

copy_list.name: Copy packing list
copy_list.description: Copies a packing list (active or archived) with the same items – nothing is packed in the copy.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the copy. Omitted = the list name followed by (copy).

add_new_defaults.name: Add new default items
add_new_defaults.description: Adds items that a newer version added to the default list to your master list. Your own items are not changed.

items.name: Items
items.description: Names of the new default items. Omitted = all.

skip_new_defaults.name: Skip new default items
skip_new_defaults.description: Marks new default items as seen without adding them.

items.name: Items
items.description: Names of the new default items. Omitted = all.

set_active_list.name: Set active packing list
set_active_list.description: Makes a packing list the active one (opened by the card and followed by 'Packing list remaining'). Without a list the active one is cleared.

entity_id.name: Packing list
entity_id.description: The packing list to make active.

not_loaded.message: Packing lists is not set up.

master_item_not_found.message: {item} is not on the master list.

list_item_not_found.message: {item} is not on the packing list.

ambiguous_item.message: {item} exists in several categories on the master list. Use the item's uid instead.

duplicate_item.message: There is already an item named {item} in that category.

init.title: Defaults for new packing lists
init.description: What new lists start with. Everything can be changed on the individual list.

data.quantity_controls: Show quantity buttons on the card

data_description.default_tags: These tags are selected when you press "+ New list".
data_description.weight_limit_kg: The weight limit new lists start with, e.g. 23 for a suitcase or 8 for hand luggage. Can be changed on each list. Applies to lists that use weight.
data_description.quantity_controls: Shows − and + next to each item on the Pack tab, so the quantity can be changed directly. Can be turned on and off on each list.
data_description.packed_mode: How packed items are shown on the card for new lists. Can be changed on each list.
